scientific_integrity: The classification is proved using complementary complete exhaustive subset methods and full automorphism search; all source programs and orbit representatives are included.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite exhaustive statement for the 20-vertex graph GP(10,2) only; the zero-forcing number six was previously known; earlier unindexed zero-forcing enumerations could overlap, and independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Complete zero-forcing and minimal-fort symmetry census of the dodecahedral graph
